description: This file manages Firebase integration for an Excalidraw-based application, including scene saving/loading, encryption/decryption of scene data, and file storage operations.

classes.name: FirebaseSceneVersionCache
classes.description: Caches scene version numbers associated with WebSocket connections to optimize scene change detection.

methods.name: encryptElements
methods.description: Encrypts an array of Excalidraw elements using a provided key, returning ciphertext and IV.

methods.name: decryptElements
methods.description: Decrypts stored scene data using a room key to retrieve the original Excalidraw elements.

methods.name: _initializeFirebase
methods.description: Initializes Firebase app instance if not already initialized.

methods.name: _getFirestore
methods.description: Retrieves Firestore instance, initializing Firebase if necessary.

methods.name: _getStorage
methods.description: Retrieves Firebase Storage instance, initializing Firebase if necessary.

methods.name: isSavedToFirebase
methods.description: Checks if the current scene is saved to Firebase by comparing scene versions.

methods.name: saveFilesToFirebase
methods.description: Uploads multiple files to Firebase Storage with cache control.

methods.name: createFirebaseSceneDocument
methods.description: Creates a Firebase scene document with encrypted scene data and version.

methods.name: saveToFirebase
methods.description: Saves the current scene to Firebase Firestore, updating or creating the scene document.

methods.name: loadFromFirebase
methods.description: Loads scene data from Firebase Firestore and decrypts it.

methods.name: loadFilesFromFirebase
methods.description: Fetches and decompresses files stored in Firebase Storage, handling errors.
